entries.note: "Parcel collected": the first row, at the depot that took it in.

entries.wording: 快件在【银川西夏网点】完成分拣,准备发往【银川转运中心】
entries.note: "Sorted at [depot], to be sent to [hub]". The status map reads every depot and destination by pattern.
"The vehicle carrying the parcel has left."

entries.wording: 快件到达【银川转运中心】
entries.note: "Arrived at [hub]." The status map reads every depot by pattern.

entries.wording: 快件到达黑河市北安市
entries.note: "Arrived in [city, county]": the town whose depot delivers it. The status map reads every town by pattern.

entries.wording: 快件分配到【黑河北安部】准备派件
entries.note: "Assigned to [depot], to be delivered": the courier takes it in the next row.

entries.wording: 快件交给派送员,正在派送途中，请耐心等待（总件数：…件）
entries.note: "Given to the courier, on its way to you, please wait (pieces: …)". The count varies.

entries.wording: 您的快件已签收，如有疑问请联系客服400 116 9596（总件数：…件）
entries.note: "Your parcel is signed for; call customer service with any question (pieces: …)". The number is the firm's own service line. The count varies.
